alerts.headline: Securities class action lawsuit filed against Smartsheet over alleged fraud disclosures
alerts.client_summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Smartsheet alleging securities fraud related to the company's failure to disclose material information during the period surrounding a 2024 acquisition offer from Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners. The deadline for lead plaintiff appointment is October 5, 2026. As a top-4 portfolio tenant in Bellevue, this litigation and associated reputational and financial risk warrants close monitoring of Smartsheet's credit profile and lease obligations.
